data_description.emoji: Shown on the calendar for counters and in labels.
data_description.color: Used for streak bands and charts.
data_description.kind: Counter: counts occurrences, emoji on the calendar. Streak: consecutive days, colored band on the calendar.
data_description.track_time: Each entry records a start and end (or duration); totals show cumulative time as well as the number of entries.
data_description.archived: Hides the habit from logging and removes its sensors. History is kept and the habit can be restored by turning this off.

log.name: Log habit
log.description: Records an occurrence. Streak habits are logged once per day; counters can be logged several times. Time-tracked habits need a start plus an end or a duration.

habit.name: Habit
habit.description: The habit's device (or its habit ID).

date.name: Date
date.description: Defaults to today. Not used for time-tracked habits.

end.name: End
end.description: Time-tracked habits only. Use either end or duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Time-tracked habits only. Use either end or duration.

backfill.name: Back-fill habit
backfill.description: Logs a date range and/or a list of dates. Days already logged are skipped, so it is safe to re-run. Not for time-tracked habits.

habit.name: Habit
habit.description: The habit's device (or its habit ID).

start_date.name: Range start
start_date.description: First day of a continuous run.

end_date.name: Range end
end_date.description: Last day, inclusive. Defaults to range start.

dates.name: Individual dates
dates.description: YYYY-MM-DD dates separated by commas, spaces or new lines.

update_entry.name: Update entry
update_entry.description: Changes an entry's date, times, notes or habit.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: From the card or the list entries action.

habit.name: Habit
habit.description: Move the entry to another habit.

start.name: Start
start.description: New start (time-tracked habits). Without an end or duration, the length is kept.

delete_entry.name: Delete entry
delete_entry.description: Deletes a habit entry or journal entry.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: From the card or the list entries action.

merge_habits.name: Merge habits
merge_habits.description: Moves all entries from one habit into another, then archives the source. For streak targets, same-day duplicates are dropped.

source.name: Source habit
source.description: Entries are moved out of this habit.

target.name: Target habit
target.description: Entries are moved into this habit.

list_entries.name: List entries
list_entries.description: Returns entries (and journal entries when no habit is given) for an optional date range.

journal.name: Add journal entry
journal.description: Records journal values keyed by field name or ID.

values.name: Values
values.description: Field name to value as an object, for example Energy: 4 and Weight: 81.2 (YAML) or the JSON shown in the example.

update_journal_entry.name: Update journal entry
update_journal_entry.description: Changes a journal entry's date or values. A null value removes that field from the entry.

values.name: Values
values.description: Field name to new value; null removes it.

reset_counter.name: Reset counter
reset_counter.description: Starts the counter's "since reset" totals from now (or a given time). Entries are kept and all-time totals are unchanged. Counters only.

habit.name: Habit
habit.description: The counter's device (or its habit ID).

at.name: Reset time
at.description: Optional; defaults to now. Use to backdate a reset you forgot.

undo_reset.name: Undo last reset
undo_reset.description: Removes the most recent reset; "since reset" totals then count from the previous reset (or all time).

habit.name: Habit
habit.description: The counter's device (or its habit ID).

habit_archived.message: {habit} is archived. Restore it in its habit settings first.

time_required.message: This habit tracks time: provide a start plus an end or a duration (not a date).

time_not_supported.message: {habit} does not track time; provide a date instead of start, end or duration.

date_required.message: Provide a date: this entry has times but its habit does not track time.

end_and_duration.message: Provide either an end or a duration, not both.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

duration_too_long.message: A single period cannot exceed {days} days.

merge_same.message: Source and target must be different habits.

merge_incompatible.message: {source} has time-tracked entries, but {target} does not track time.

backfill_timed.message: {habit} tracks time; log each period instead of back-filling dates.

backfill_empty.message: Provide a date range or a list of dates.

journal_empty.message: The journal entry has no values.

reset_streak.message: {habit} is a streak habit; only counters can be reset.
